title: Unit 2 Consolidation
goal: Review events and background, the pluperfect, verbs that change meaning, time connectors and the polite imperfect, and read a text about Juan Rulfo.

items: Review the preterite and the imperfect in a story, the pluperfect and the verbs that change meaning in the past.
Review the time connectors and the polite imperfect.
Read a text in the past about the writer Juan Rulfo and his novel Pedro Páramo.
I can tell a short story in the past with the events, the scene and what had happened before in the right tenses.
I can say that I met, found out, tried or managed something with conocí, supe, quise and pude.
I can control the speed of a story with time connectors.
I can read a short text in the past about a writer and his book.
